prompt: Write a quest page for The Red Wake. Umberlee's escalation should wait indefinitely for the party — the Dead Lady appears the night after the party arrives at any port, no matter when that is.

assertions.text: Activity: escalation has its own timeline — portents advance whether the party is present or not
Early arrival produces different situation than mid or late arrival
Tide driven by Umberlee's established want and constraints, not by party arrival
Causality: each portent follows from the prior through Umberlee's methods (weather, Dead Lady, Waveservants)
Quest frame names incompatible wants, live pressure, and uninterrupted consequence
Does not make the Dead Lady appear only upon party arrival at a port
